values.en: For a plane curve $\gamma\colon(a,b)\to\mathbb{R}^{2}$ parametrized by arc length one has $\gamma''=k_{\gamma}\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}$, i.e. $\gamma''(t)=k_{\gamma}(t)\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}(t)$. Indeed $\lVert T\rVert=1$ with $T=\gamma'$ forces $T'\perp T$, and in the plane the orthogonal complement of $T$ is spanned by $\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}=JT$; hence $T'=\langle T',\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}\rangle\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}=k_{\gamma}\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}$. Since $T=\gamma'$ on an arc-length parametrization, $T'=\gamma''$.
values.zh-CN: 对以弧长参数化的平面曲线 $\gamma\colon(a,b)\to\mathbb{R}^{2}$ 有 $\gamma''=k_{\gamma}\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}$，即 $\gamma''(t)=k_{\gamma}(t)\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}(t)$。事实上 $T=\gamma'$ 满足 $\lVert T\rVert=1$，迫使 $T'\perp T$，而平面中 $T$ 的正交补由 $\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}=JT$ 张成；故 $T'=\langle T',\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}\rangle\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}=k_{\gamma}\boldsymbol{n}_{\gamma}$。由于弧长参数下 $T=\gamma'$，所以 $T'=\gamma''$。
